suggestions.description: Mirror the model-weight, binary and archive exclusions from .gitignore, and exclude .env.*. This hardens build-context handling against locally accumulated artifacts; no such sensitive files were found in the staged publication.
Copy LICENSE, NOTICE and licenses/ into both image variants so the repository's derivative attribution also accompanies container distributions.

Read tracked contents directly from staged Git blobs and record an index-content digest with scan results. Working-tree reads plus the staged diff are not an exact staged-snapshot audit, particularly when files change during review.
Add CPU-only argv tests for deploy/run.py, and run the existing launcher tests in the digest Dockerfile as well as the source Dockerfile.

summary: Reviewed the final 115-file staged diff, including all 11 patches. Independently reconstructed all 34 changed runtime paths in memory: patch hashes, manifest path coverage, resulting bytes and Python syntax match. A fresh local heuristic secret scan found no findings; staged whitespace checks passed. Reviewed the supplied CPU log and staged 37+2-test report without rerunning tests. No confirmed blocking packaging bug or unsupported equivalence claim found. Full-image, registry and benchmark attestations remain supplied evidence, not independently reverified here. No files modified or GPU, production or remote services accessed. Reviewed staged-diff SHA-256: 60d52bcb9e4f7d10815bfa0811d5aae56f814877b57192855ea63260dcba6b01.
